title: focuser_primaluce ended a SESTO SENSO 3 calibration OK while the controller reported a lost coordinate
summary: The SESTO SENSO 3 (firmware 1.0.9) sometimes reports ABS_POS_STEP 1000000 with STATUS.HIZ 1, apparently after losing its coordinate. Once a finished calibration was published OK with that value as the position, far outside the range just stored (target 13995, value 1000000).
evidence: 20261023091538-dfa4-primaluce-calibration-position-check/verification.md (FND); requester report 2026-10-23; ABS_POS_STEP 1000000 HIZ 1 in five session logs

resolution.evidence: 20261023091538-dfa4-primaluce-calibration-position-check/verification.md: END checks the position against the new range and fails the calibration with a rerun message; sestosenso3_calibration_lost_position passes and fails without the check; recorded run 64/64. Not reproduced on hardware.
